items: Launch Date
Approved on August 24, 2024, by the Union Cabinet.
Objective
To strengthen the Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) ecosystem in India.
Consolidate and streamline existing programs for better resource utilization and coordination.
Implementation Period
Indian Economy Scheme
Covers the 15th Finance Commission period: 2021-22 to 2025-26.
Budget Allocation
Total outlay: ₹10,579.84 crore.
Special Focus Areas
Women in STEM: Encouraging female participation in Science, Technology, Engineering, and
Mathematics.
Sustainable Development: Addressing challenges in renewable energy, climate change, and
environmental conservation.
Alignment with Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF): Ensures research initiatives
meet global standards while addressing India-specific needs.
Goals
Align programs with Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.
Establish India as a global leader in innovation and technology development.
